known_parity_gaps: GAP-torn-compaction-project-canonical: planner.plan is not run. A missing canonical codec call is not a successful plan. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_conservative_default_blocks_salvage checks a fingerprint for three fixtures. One fixture inside a sweep is not the whole test. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_salvage_opt_in compares a plan dict for three recipes. One recipe inside a sweep is not the whole test. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_salvage_recipe_applications plans and then applies. No fingerprint is hashed and no fixture diff is stored. No output bytes are stored.

GAP-torn-compaction-project-session-copy: a kept SessionEvent copies in the pin. This crate stops on that value. A rust seam while the pin succeeds is not coverage. That success is not replayed. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_salvage_recipe_applications uses SessionEvent records from the fixture. One recipe inside a sweep is not the whole test.

GAP-torn-compaction-project-payload: tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_salvage_recipe_applications carries payload on the events. This set does not store payload content. A payload-free result is not that test. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_salvage_opt_in and tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_conservative_default_blocks_salvage load the same fixture.

GAP-torn-compaction-project-bool: an in-range bool is an index in the pin. True selects the event at index 1 when the session length is greater than one and that event is the boundary. The published function returns a different error. This set does not claim that success. A rust seam while the pin succeeds is not coverage. That success is not replayed. False selects index 0. When that event is not a compaction_boundary the pin refuses with a different message. When that event is a projecting boundary the pin succeeds. The published function returns a different error. This set does not claim that refusal and does not claim that success.

GAP-torn-compaction-project-float: a float past the end and a negative float are rendered with repr in the pin when no unique compaction_boundary is found. The published function returns a different error. This set does not claim that refusal. An in-range float raises TypeError before the event is read. That TypeError is an extra vector and is not a whole pinned test. A zero float is in range and raises that same TypeError. It is not a rendered refusal. A float kind is rendered with str in the pin and the no-split refusal follows. The published function returns a different error. This set does not claim that refusal.

GAP-torn-compaction-project-sweep: tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_salvage_recipe_applications applies three recipes and checks loss. One recipe inside a sweep is not the whole test. A successful project that also checks loss, plan, or canonical bytes is not covered by the event list alone. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_torn_compaction_direct_apply_validation is three refusals of one function. The covered vector contains every refusal in that test.
